resources.string: Android asks once: allow “Install unknown apps” for PHEV Link, then come back here.

The bridge is restarting — back in a moment…

No charge timer is set in the car, so it charges as soon as it\'s plugged in. With a timer, the car waits for its time — then “Charge now” starts at once, and “Back to the charge timer” makes it wait again.
The car has a charge timer: plugged in, it waits for the timer\'s time. “Charge now” starts charging at once; “Back to the charge timer” makes it wait for the timer again.
